T: Does for rock and roll what The Sound of Music did for hills.
D: A filmmaker follows England's loudest band on a 1982 American tour as the gigs shrink, the drummers keep dying and the amps go to 11.
P: Bring out the rolls when Nigel takes on the miniature bread backstage.
S: Nigel's large bread salami and provolone rolls
Nigel can't work the miniature bread

Stir the chopped olives through the mayo. Split the rolls and spread both sides with the olive mayo. Lay the salami flat, no folding, then the provolone, capsicum and rocket. Close, press down and cut in half.
1 roasted red capsicum from a jar, sliced@Pantry
Crumbed olives with the pimentos left in
Backstage, the olives came with no pimentos

Roll the olives in flour, then egg, then the panko mixed with parmesan. Fry in hot oil in batches until golden, about 2 minutes. Stir lemon zest and juice through the yoghurt and serve with the hot olives.
300g pimento-stuffed green olives, drained and patted dry@Pantry
M: None more black pastrami on dark rye
Pastrami on dark rye with Russian dressing. Smell the Glove comes out none more black.

Mix the mayo, tomato sauce and horseradish into a Russian dressing. Steam the pastrami in a covered pan with a splash of water until hot and soft. Spread the rye with mustard and dressing, pile on the pastrami and crack over pepper. Add the Swiss, toast the sandwiches in a pan until the cheese melts, and serve with pickles.
The Shark Sandwich review ran to two words

Stir the capers, gherkins and a squeeze of lemon through the mayo. Whisk the flour, soda water and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter. Dip the flake and fry at 180C until puffed and golden. Split the rolls, add lettuce and fish, and spoon over the tartare.
W: Fudgy brownies stacked like Stonehenge, in inches not feet

Melt the chocolate and butter, then whisk in the sugar and eggs. Fold in the flour, cocoa and a pinch of salt and spread in a lined 20cm tin. Bake at 170C until just set, then cool completely. Cut into tall slabs and stand them in a circle with one laid across the top, then dust with icing sugar. Whip the cream to soft peaks and serve on the side.
K: Rum and Coke over 11 ice cubes. Nigel's amps go one louder.
Drop 11 ice cubes into each of 4 tall glasses. Pour 60ml rum into each, top with Coke and squeeze in a lime wedge.
